name: iFrame embed code generator
title: iFrame Generator: Responsive Embed Code for Any Page or Video
description: Generate clean, responsive iframe embed code. Converts YouTube, Vimeo, Loom and Spotify links, sets permissions and sandbox, and previews it live.
summary: Responsive embed code for pages and videos, with a live preview.
howTo: Paste the address of the page or video. YouTube, Vimeo, Loom and Spotify links are converted to their embed address automatically.
Give it a short title — screen readers announce it, so describe what's inside (for example, “Product demo video”).
Choose Responsive to fill the width of your page at a fixed shape, or Fixed size for exact pixels.
Copy the code and paste it into your page's HTML, or into the “custom HTML” block of your site builder.

faq.a: Many sites (most banks, social networks and search engines) send a header that forbids being shown inside another page. The browser obeys it and shows nothing. If the site offers an official “Embed” option, use the address it gives you.

faq.q: How do I make an iframe responsive?
faq.a: Give it width:100% and an aspect-ratio, with height:auto. That's what the Responsive option writes, and it works in every current browser without wrapper divs.
It locks the embedded page down: no scripts, forms, pop-ups or cookies unless you allow each one. Use it for content you don't fully trust.
